title: Limit cone for a K-injective tower
statement: Let A be an abelian category with exact countable products and enough injectives, with derived category D(A) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] equipped with any chosen countable products. For every K-injective cochain complex I of inverse systems indexed by the opposite of the natural numbers, its associated functor from that indexing category to cochain complexes over A has a limit cone.

proof.text: Countable products in A induce countable products of complexes. The tower has countably many objects and arrows. Products indexed by these two sets and equalizers construct the limit, using Mathlib hasLimit_of_equalizer_and_product.

proof_origin.note: Proved from Mathlib products and equalizers, without K-injectivity.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedCategory_towerLimit_cone
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCountableProducts A] [CountableAB4Star A]
    (hP : HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory A)) :
    letI : HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory A) := hP
    ∀ (_ : EnoughInjectives A)
      (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective],
      ∃ c : Cone I.asFunctor, Nonempty (IsLimit c)
